bank.retain_mission: Extract durable, explicit and temporally anchored facts from already-authorized SuperMemory memories. Preserve uncertainty and contradiction.
bank.observations_mission: Consolidate recurring current-state patterns while preserving contradiction, temporal qualifiers and source facts.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize only retrieved evidence, surface uncertainty and never claim authority or execute actions.

directives.name: grounded-current-state
directives.content: Use retrieved evidence only. State conflicts and uncertainty. Do not infer permission, authority or external action.
